title: Top 8 public companies in this screen
ranking_method_plain: Public companies only (verified ticker). Ranked by sourced federal dollars: flagship notices in the Jun 3–Sep 1 2026 window, plus 12-month USAspending new primes in nuclear / magnets / semiconductors. Status weights: FINAL or paid cash counts at 1.00; CONDITIONAL at 0.40; letter of intent (LOI) at 0.15; undefinitized contract action (UCA) obligated cash at 1.00 and UCA face/ceiling at 0.05 because face is not cash; loan facilities at 0.40 even when tagged FINAL. Duplicate Centrus rows in curated.json and awards.json are counted once. We did not pad to 20.
disclaimer: This is a federal-money screen, not a buy list, not investment advice. Past awards do not mean the stock will go up. We do not invent growth percentages, price targets, or forecasts. Rank is not a prediction of returns. Close-to-close historical returns on ticker rows are not forecasts.
note: We did not pad to 20. Eight verified public tickers: LMT, RTX, LEU, USAR, PCG, GFS, ABB, and BWXT (new from the 12-month HPDU prime). MP, IBM, OKLO, IONQ stay context-only. Lab equipment buys to IPG/MKS/Qualcomm/Wolfspeed are not ranked.
